findings.summary: Historical carry-forward accepts a digest-bound report labeled final_green without proving successful collection and execution for each exact scoped case.
findings.evidence: The validator checks report digest and identity, requires execution phases to be final_green, then builds a set of test_id values from cases labeled final_green/passed. It never checks that a matching execution has integer exit_code 0 and collection_status ok, nor that each required test ID has exactly one case matching the accepted case_id and runner_id. Thus a checkpoint-retained, digest-valid report with failed collection/nonzero execution or duplicate case rows (one passed and one failed) can satisfy old_scope.issubset(passed) and authorize TaskResult carry-forward. The repository's completion evaluator requires successful collection and exit code (completion.py:90-94), rejects duplicate final cases (117-119), and verifies exact case/runner identity (100-107); workbench_evidence.py:246 also rejects non-ok collection. The new T56 fixture reports omit exit_code and collection_status and still count as Green, demonstrating this gap in the carry-forward proof.
findings.requested_change: Validate the historical report with equivalent final-Green integrity checks: exact unique scoped case identities, exact runner/case bindings, valid execution linkage, collection_status=ok, integer exit_code=0, and passed outcome for every required old test. Update T56 fixtures to use valid reports and add malformed digest-valid historical reports (failed collection/nonzero exit and duplicate case identity) that cannot authorize carry-forward.

summary: The append-only checkpoint correction resolves the prior CR2-REV-34469-F01: it preserves checkpointed artifacts, requires the old ledger as an exact prefix, requires the specific historical Green row/report to be checkpointed, and allows appended run artifacts. T56 verifies both append compatibility and tampering rejection. However, historical carry-forward still trusts Green labels without validating execution success or exact case identity, so a malformed but checkpoint-retained report can authorize reuse of an old TaskResult. The candidate-bound TaskResult records Red/Green for the append regression and reports 45 recovery/reliability tests plus inner-loop validation passing; those checks do not cover this missing historical-report integrity condition.
